text:
ops-bot: @channel Policy + GA checklist for Blackwell B500 Dedicated pools. Please read and action if you own any part of the stack.
eli_pm: TL;DR: We are formalizing GA prerequisites for B500. These are higher bar than previous previews due to customer SLA expectations and new firmware risks.
sanjay_infra: New GA prerequisites (short): 1) Firmware holdback policy and vendor sign-off 2) Automated ECC + thermal remediation 3) HSM/KMS parity in GA regions 4) Perf regressions <5% vs baseline on long-context workloads 5) Runbook + auto-drain playbook in main runbook repo.
marina_prod: From product: we'll also need per-route latency SLO configs in Console and a token-cost delta estimate for customers who opt into B500 vs existing pools.
carlos_sre: SRE items: define p50/p95 SLO targets per region, ensure alerting on ECC spikes and thermal >82C, and create an emergency firmware rollback runbook. I'll add these to the b500-sre epic.
anya_sales: GTM: until GA is announced, GTM must use the phrase "performance pilot" only. No GA dates, no reserved capacity promises. If sales want to convert pilot partners to reserved contracts pre-GA, loop legal and finance; we only permit a limited opt-in list.
ben_security: Security/Compliance: GA requires KMS/HSM parity across GA regions and keys managed via our key-rotation automation. Preview pools without full compliance must be labelled and blocked from regulated tenants. Do not run regulated data on preview pools.
tom_gtm: Question: are we changing default session caps for GA? Partners complained about short eval windows.
sanjay_infra: For GA we'll support configurable session caps per tenant with a max of 72h by default. Preview remains conservative (8-24h depending on region). We will publish an infra-admin API to request overrides. Example CLI:
```
redwood infra override-session --tenant=acme --pool=b500-eu1 --duration=48h --reason="eval"
```
lucy_eng: Engineering ask: need a formal latency-expectation doc to put in the console so customers can set SLOs. Marina, can product own a short doc with p50/p95 and test harness notes?
marina_prod: Yes  I'll draft a "B500: Expected perf and tuning" doc and link it from Console. Target: publish draft by Fri COB.
carlos_sre: Incident mitigation: until firmware is fully validated, we will enforce rolling upgrades with auto-drain and a 30m cooldown window. Any firmware flagged by vendor will be held until SRE + infra approve.
eli_pm: Timeline: this is the week of stability hardening. If all blockers clear we aim to sign off GA readiness in 3 weeks. GA rollout will be region-phased and gated by compliance checks.
ben_security: Action: security will deliver a compliance checklist and HSM run-through steps in 5 business days.
anya_sales: Action for GTM: compile list of pilot partners who should be invited to opt-in reserved trials (deadline: EOD Wed).
sanjay_infra: Ops action: add ECC auto-retry and thermal auto-throttle to infra by Tue; enable per-tenant session override API by next week.
carlos_sre: SRE action: add firmware rollback playbook and adjust page thresholds to be more conservative for new hardware.
lucy_eng: Eng action: wire console SLO display and add a perf CI that runs nightly on B500 pools.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Epics created: b500-ga-readiness, b500-sre, b500-security-checklist. If you hit any roadblocks tag the appropriate epic and DM owners. Thanks everyone!
